objective.name: mcp.initialize
objective.description: Handle an MCP initialize request by loading the Brique cognitive framework matter and returning it to the LLM as its active reasoning context.

#root.role: Transform an MCP initialize request into an MCP initialize response carrying the Brique cognitive framework as the LLM active context.

effects.llm_context: The LLM session receives the Brique cognitive framework as its active reasoning context.

transformation_contract.morphing: An uncontextualized MCP initialize request becomes an initialized LLM session carrying the full Brique cognitive framework as its active reasoning context.
invariants: The cognitive framework content is never modified during loading.
The MCP protocol fields remain conformant with protocol version 2024-11-05.
success: The response includes a valid protocol_version, server_info, and capabilities.
The context field contains the full text content of the brique_cognitive_framework matter.
failure: The capacity fails when the brique_cognitive_framework matter cannot be read from Brique.
The capacity fails when the matter substance is unavailable or empty.
notes: This capacity is internal to the MCP bridge wrapper and is never invoked directly from Brique.

#read_framework.role: Retrieve the full text content of the brique_cognitive_framework matter from Brique.

transformation_contract.morphing: The brique_cognitive_framework matter substance becomes an in-memory text available for response assembly.
success: framework_content contains the full non-empty text of brique_cognitive_framework.
failure: The section fails when matter.read returns an error or empty substance.

#build_response.role: Assemble the MCP initialize response from the loaded framework content and static server metadata.

transformation_contract.morphing: The loaded framework text and static server metadata become a well-formed MCP initialize response payload returned to the LLM.
invariants: context carries the framework_content without truncation.
success: The payload conforms to the MCP initialize response structure.
context is non-empty and contains the full framework text.
failure: The section fails when framework_content is empty.
